messages:
jordan: Heads-up — AcmeCorp SIG is back. They want question-by-question evidence for encryption + key management before legal signs PO. Deadline EOD Wed.
mina: ok which SIG QIDs do they need called out?
teja: they flagged Q3.2 (KMS) and Q4.1 (rotation + separation of duties). also asked for pen-test and SOC2 links. timeline is tight. :grimacing:
jordan: exact wording from buyer: 'Please provide the KMS architecture diagram, key rotation policy, and a signed attestation for SOC2 + recent penetration test report.'
mina: I can pull rotation policy & KMS IAM snippets. I need someone to grab the diagram (private deployment) — it's under infra diagrams (confluence).
nana: (note: i'm ana, solutions eng on the deal) I have the VPC/KMS diagram for the POC cluster — can export PNG. Will add redactions for prod metadata.
teja: sweet. Jordan — can we push docs to a secure share? buyer insisted on a zip container with checksums.
jordan: yes, they gave an upload link to their portal. We'll bundle into a signed zip.
mina: evidence checklist: 1) KMS diagram PNG (proof of architecture) 2) KMS key policy snippet + rotation policy doc 3) SOC2 attestation PDF 4) Pen-test summary (redacted) 5) Config snippet showing CMK usage in Dedicated/private
ana: I can attach 1 and 5. Mina — can you post the key policy snippet as a code block so review can confirm exact ARNs?
mina: sure — posting snippet now:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
ana: perfect. I'll embed that in the zip README.
sree: FYI for Private deployments we use customer-managed KMS by default; for Hosted we rotate CMKs every 90 days with automated rotation. I can draft the rotation policy language for the attestation.
teja: who has the SOC2 PDF?
jordan: legal uploaded our SOC2 Type II to the secure bucket last month. evidence-bot: Document uploaded to evidence-bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/acmecorp/sig_package_1765439876.zip (sha256: 3a7f...c9b) :white_check_mark:
mina: added pen-test summary (redacted) to bucket. Also included a pointer to full pentest report (NDA required).
nana: packing diagrams now. I'll remove instance IDs and internal IPs.
teja: buyer also asked for 'controls owner contact' on Q4.1 — who should we list?
sree: list me (sree@redwood.ai) as controls owner for KMS rotation. Mina is backup.
jordan: timeline: Ana exports diagram by EOD today, Mina posts rotation policy & snippet, Sree drafts attestation, I will upload and push to buyer portal tomorrow morning.
teja: noted. I'll message buyer to confirm upload window so they accept our zip tomorrow AM.
mina: one last check — do we include a sample CloudTrail event proving key usage? Might speed review.
nana: I can grab a sanitized CloudTrail snippet (no ARNs) and include as example.
sree: great. once everything in bucket, i'll sign the attestation PDF and mark thread resolved.
jordan: thanks team. tagging followups: @mina pls confirm policy version; @ana pls post diagram link when ready; @teja pls confirm buyer portal window. :thumbsup:
(evidence-bot): upload event recorded 2024-11-07T16:00:12Z -> /acmecorp/sig_package_1765439876.zip
